[[File:MC80_Battle_Cruiser_SWA.png|thumb|right|250px|The Allied Armada]]
The '''Allied Armada''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Old Mandalorians/Legends|Old Mandalorian]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that participated in the [[Battle of Xorrn]]. It consisted of at least two [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Liberty type Star Cruisers]], and at least five [[MC30c frigate/Legends|MC30c frigates]].
